description: Read the Telegram alert filters of the logged-in user: seller alerts (remaining amount, duration, price and APY ranges, unlocked-only) and buyer alerts (reclaim warning time, low energy / bandwidth thresholds). `setting` is null when Telegram is not linked. Read these before changing them with `tronsave_update_telegram_notify_setting` (which replaces whole filter objects). For in-app alerts use `tronsave_list_notifications`. Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only.
name: tronsave_get_telegram_notify_setting
title: Telegram Notification Settings
